title: Identity-Aware Recurrent Text Classifier
summary: The solution tokenizes lowercased comments with a word/punctuation regex, builds a 120,000-token vocabulary from training rows, maps unknown tokens to a dedicated ID, and head-truncates sequences to 220 tokens. It pretrains 300-dimensional word embeddings on training text using skip-gram negative sampling with frequency-based subsampling and a 0.75-powered noise distribution. A spatially dropped embedding sequence is encoded by a bidirectional LSTM followed by a bidirectional GRU. Max and masked-mean pooling from both encoder outputs are concatenated, processed by a residual dense ReLU/dropout block, and fed to one toxicity and multiple identity logits. Training uses mean-normalized identity-aware toxicity weights plus unweighted binary cross-entropy auxiliary identity loss. AdamW, mixed precision gradient scaling, gradient clipping, epochwise learning-rate decay, and shuffled length-bucketed batches are used. Inference applies sigmoid to toxicity logits and averages predictions from the final two epochs.
